step7b_device_only_detection_vs_shep.consistency_note: same operating threshold (reused exactly) and same order of magnitude for detection and lead. My device-only detection rate is lower than a naive 39/N read of StudySH-EP because the units differ: StudySH-EP EP-G episodes are event-anchored 21-frame windows ending at the event (every frame is pre-event), while the D192 episodes are the workload's (play_id, pos//21) 21-frame blocks, which are not anchored on the event, so a crash near an episode boundary has fewer pre-event instants in which to cross. This is a reported, explained difference, not a threshold or scorer mismatch.
